cards.announcement: # Software QA Engineer, Test Automation - Tesla, Grünheide (Mark) URL: https://www.eurotechjobs.com/job_display/294952/Software_QA_Engineer_Test_Automation_Tesla_Grnheide_Mark_Germany Software QA Engineer, Test Automation - Tesla, Grünheide (Mark) ## Grünheide (Mark), Germany As a Software QA Engineer for factory applications, you will focus on designing and implementing automated test scenarios to increase test coverage and build confidence in software releases. You will perform functional testing of manufacturing systems and work closely with developers to ensure high-quality, reliable solutions. Your focus on automation and process improvement will drive efficiency and continuous quality enhancement across our development and releases cycles. ### What You’ll Do - Work with software developers to define test strategies and automate test cases for factory applications - Design, develop, and enhance Tesla’s automated test frameworks using open-source solutions. - Stay informed of current methodologies and technologies, contribute to and participate in the evaluation of new strategies and/or technologies to improve software quality - Log, manage, and retest defects using issue tracking system - Report testing status, milestones and issues to project stakeholders - Maintain high standard of internal documentation with a special focus on traceability and change validation ### What You’ll Bring Degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience - Solid understanding of general concepts and best practices of software engineering - Hands-on software development experience working with one or more of Java (preferred), TypeScript, C# and Go - Experience with CI/CD toolchains using common technologies such as Git, Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins - Profirciency in API testing automation (REST) - Hands-on experience with Playwright (preferred), Cypress, Selenium is must-have - Working experience with relational databases and SQL is required - Knowledge of performing testing tools such as K6, JMeter is a big plus - Previous experience with Kafka and deep understanding of streaming architectures is a big plus

# Senior Software Engineer - AI Agents Testing - Zendesk, Berlin, Krakow or Lisbon URL: https://www.eurotechjobs.com/job_display/294532/Senior_Software_Engineer_AI_Agents_Testing_Zendesk_Berlin_Krakow_or_Lisbon_Multiple_Countries Senior Software Engineer - AI Agents Testing - Zendesk, Berlin, Krakow or Lisbon ## Berlin, Krakow or Lisbon As a Senior Fullstack Engineer on this team, you’ll be a key technical contributor shaping the systems, tooling, and workflows that power AI agent evaluation at scale. While this is a fullstack role, it leans more on backend development as we’re looking for someone who is deeply comfortable with APIs, event-driven systems, testing infrastructure, data workflows, and platform thinking, while also being able to design and deliver polished user-facing tools when needed. You’ll collaborate closely with product managers, designers, data engineers, applied AI/ML partners, and fellow engineers to build internal and customer-facing capabilities that improve the quality of our AI agents. In this role, you’ll not only ship features end-to-end, but also help shape technical direction, raise the bar on engineering quality, and influence how the team solves complex problems. Your work will directly impact how Zendesk validates and improves its AI agents, helping ensure our products are trustworthy, measurable, and effective. ### What You Bring to the Role - 5+ years of experience building modern web applications using TypeScript, React, and Node.js. - Strong experience designing and building backend services, APIs, and event-driven systems. - Strong understanding of software engineering best practices, including clean architecture, testing strategy, observability, and maintainability. - Experience working across the stack and delivering polished, performant, accessible user experiences. - Ability to independently drive complex projects from ambiguity to execution, while partnering effectively across functions. - Excellent communication skills, proactive mindset and the ability to influence technical decisions, align stakeholders, and mentor other engineers. - You are a product-minded engineer, you care deeply about the end-user experience and proactively contribute ideas to improve product outcomes. - Comfort working in fast-moving, cross-functional environments and iterating based on feedback. - A drive for continuous learning, reflection, and improvement, in both your own growth and your team’s success. - You are eager to expand into ML engineering and learn how it connects to evaluation, testing, and the lifecycle of AI systems. ### A big plus if you - Are familiar with AWS, and comfortable with CI/CD pipelines. - Have a good understanding of microservice architecture, event-driven systems, and relational/NoSQL data modeling. - Have experience with AI agentic tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, and similar developer assistants. - Have experience with Python, especially for testing, automation, data processing, or scripting. - Have prior experience building evaluation systems, synthetic testing pipelines, or AI quality tooling.

# Senior DevOps Engineer - Webfleet, Leipzig URL: https://www.eurotechjobs.com/job_display/296568/Senior_DevOps_Engineer_Webfleet_Leipzig_Germany Senior DevOps Engineer - Webfleet, Leipzig #### As part of the team, you will: - Design, improve, and maintain cloud-based infrastructure and platform services; - Work with AWS and Kubernetes to operate scalable and reliable services; - Build, maintain, and optimize CI/CD pipelines; - Automate infrastructure and operational processes using tools such as Terraform; - Use Java and/or Groovy to develop, maintain, and improve automation, tooling, pipelines, and platform-related services; - Collaborate with development teams, architects, product owners, and system engineers to support reliable delivery of new features; - Improve monitoring, logging, metrics, alerting, and operational visibility using tools such as Grafana; - Support stability, performance, quality assurance, incident prevention, and continuous improvement; - Help improve deployment processes, release automation, and service operations; - Identify, prevent, and resolve potential security and operational risks; - Contribute to code reviews, infrastructure reviews, and technical discussions. ### Who are you? There is no single path to becoming part of Webfleet. #### However, to be successful in this role, we imagine you bring the following: - Solid experience as a DevOps engineer, platform engineer, cloud engineer, or similar role; - Strong Java and/or Groovy development skills; - Hands-on experience with AWS and Kubernetes; - Experience with CI/CD pipelines and tools such as Jenkins; - Experience with container technologies such as Docker; - Experience with infrastructure as code, preferably Terraform; - A good understanding of cloud infrastructure, service operations, automation, monitoring, and reliability; - An interest in working closely with software engineers, architects, component owners, and system engineers; - Strong communication skills, an analytical mindset, and a goal-oriented, quality-focused approach; - Knowledge of PostgreSQL would be a plus; - A willingness to learn and adopt new technologies as needed by the team; - Fluency in English.

# Quality Assurance Engineer - EUMETSAT - European Organisation for the Exploitation of Meteorological Satellites, Darmstadt URL: https://www.eurotechjobs.com/job_display/296784/Quality_Assurance_Engineer_EUMETSAT_European_Organisation_for_the_Exploitation_of_Meteorological_Satellites_Darmstadt_Germany Quality Assurance Engineer - EUMETSAT - European Organisation for the Exploitation of Meteorological Satellites, Darmstadt ## Darmstadt, Germany EUMETSAT is Europe’s meteorological satellite agency - monitoring the weather and climate from space - 24 hours a day, 365 days a year. This is your chance to contribute to a world leading earth observation programme, set to generate global weather forecasting and climate monitoring benefits. As a Quality Assurance Engineer you will be at the heart of ensuring all elements of this complex system work together to deliver world leading meteorological products. In the EUMETSAT matrix organisation, the Technical and Scientific Support (TSS) department provides support to the development and operations of EUMETSAT satellite systems, in particular ground systems, as well as quality assurance and management support services to the full organisation, through its Process Assurance and Management Support Division (PRS). The selected Quality Assurance Engineer will be part of the TSS Quality Assurance team and closely collaborate with the engineering and scientific teams in TSS. She/he will be a member of TSS-led engineering development projects and will provide support to the maintenance and evolution of EUMETSAT operational systems and services and to other engineering-related activities adopting new technologies in line with the organisation’s multi-mission approach. ### Duties - Provide quality and product assurance for the maintenance and evolution of operational ground systems and support services, including organisation of reviews and management and follow up of technical investigations; - Define and ensure applicability of Quality and Product Assurance requirements for technical/engineering support contracts and monitor their implementation, including reporting and acting upon detected deviations, anomalies and non-conformities; - Plan and perform project quality assurance activities in support to project management, including the definition and tailoring of the applicable Quality and Product Assurance requirements, organisation of reviews and provision of key project quality indicators, identifying non-conformities with regards to the applicable processes and facilitating the project risk management process; - Provide Quality and Product Assurance support in acceptance processes (e.g. Incoming Inspections), tests related reviews (e.g. Test Readiness Review/Test Review Board), acceptance related reviews, management of anomalies, etc.); - Provide Product Assurance support to the Ground Segment System, Software and IT Infrastructure components, including the provision of expert support in the review of related deliveries and during technical investigations and milestones; - Define, analyse, and improve Quality Assurance processes of relevance to the TSS engineering activities, development projects and operations support services; - Monitor the effective implementation of QA processes and requirements, and reporting on any relevant findings, gaps and issues; - Participate in Internal Quality Audits and Quality Audits on external contractors/suppliers as necessary, to ensure their established processes are appropriate to fulfil the contracts they hold with EUMETSAT, in line with EUMETSAT requirements; - Support the harmonisation and standardisation of organisational processes for all QA aspects, contributing to their continual improvement; - Ensure lessons learnt in TSS projects are gathered, assessed, recorded and implemented/applied as relevant to subsequent projects; - Provide Quality and Product Assurance training to TSS personnel. ### What we offer - Generous salary, of up to Euro 8,500/month NET (after income tax) based on skills and experience; - Flexible working time including additional flexi-leave; - Excellent medical coverage for employee and family; - Attractive pension; - 30 days of annual leave + 14.5 days public holidays; - Training and development support; - Relocation allowance and support (if applicable). #### Skills and Experience: - A minimum of five years experience in working with large-scale software-intensive systems in at least one of the following disciplines: Quality Assurance, Product Assurance or Software Engineering and general understanding of the others; - Proven professional experience of working as part of the Engineering team or the Product Assurance team, in projects developing Software Systems, including its Software and IT Infrastructure components; - Experience in Ground Segment Systems and/or software QA/PA would be an advantage; - Experience readily applicable to the space domain will be an advantage (e.g. experience in aeronautical, defence, telecommunication or automotive engineering domains facing similar challenges and relying on related technologies and methodologies); - Knowledge of system engineering standards and methodologies in aspects relevant to space operational systems; - Experience in the definition and assessment of processes, good practices and/or standards in the field of quality assurance, combined with good knowledge and practice of the ISO 9001 and/or other relevant QA standards; - Experience with new technologies such as cloud computing and Docker/Kubernetes and development methodologies (e.g. Agile, DevOps) will be an advantage; - Excellent analysis, synthesis and presentation skills; - Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to apply these to interactions within and between teams. #### Qualifications: - A university degree in engineering or computer science (or another relevant discipline); - Certification in quality assurance, management or auditing would be an advantage. ### More about us EUMETSAT’s role is to establish and operate meteorological satellites to monitor the weather and climate from space - 24 hours a day, 365 days a year. This information is supplied to the National Meteorological Services of the organisation's Member and Cooperating States in Europe, as well as other users worldwide. EUMETSAT also operates several Copernicus missions on behalf of the European Union and provide data services to the Copernicus marine and atmospheric services and their users. As an intergovernmental European Organisation, EUMETSAT can recruit nationals only from the 30 Member States (Austria, Belgium, Bulgaria, Croatia, Czech Republic, Denmark, Estonia, Finland, France, Germany, Greece, Hungary, Iceland, Ireland, Italy, Latvia, Lithuania, Luxembourg, The Netherlands, Norway, Poland, Portugal, Romania, Slovakia, Slovenia, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, Turkey and the United Kingdom).
